versions.changelog:
Initial release of idr-avatar-video skill.

- Create videos using templates or digital avatars and voice selections.
- Supports querying digital humans, voices, and video templates with paginated results (default: 10 per page).
- Provides direct user guidance and usage instructions for video generation tasks.
- Includes detailed CLI documentation for listing resources and creating videos.
- Requires Python 3 and network access to www.neural-avatar.com.
